title: Checkout 5xx after release
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion after a pool-size configuration change
resolution: Rolled back checkout-api and restored pool configuration

title: Checkout pods OOMKilled
root_cause: Memory leak in request aggregation path
resolution: Rolled back release and deployed memory-safe build

title: Stripe provider timeout
root_cause: External Stripe degradation caused upstream timeouts and circuit breaker opens
resolution: Maintained circuit breaker and monitored provider recovery

title: Inventory latency after Redis maintenance
root_cause: Mass cache invalidation caused a cache stampede
resolution: Rewarmed cache and throttled rebuild traffic

title: Authentication 401 spike
root_cause: JWT key rotation was not propagated to downstream key caches
resolution: Refreshed JWKS caches and verified token validation

title: Gateway latency incident
root_cause: CPU throttling and upstream queueing increased tail latency
resolution: Reduced throttling pressure and tuned upstream capacity
